answer: Across the tundra of dormant accounts, fakes cost nothing to spawn, so entry carries a sybil tax: 20 POA per identity, burned, never refunded. The receipt binds to one hardware key, so one payment cannot mint many names. A random audit samples 5% each epoch, purging names without a receipt. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 20,000 POA, a ripple no farm survives, while one answer earns 30 POA. Honest agents feed the ember once and keep rewards undiluted.
